summary: Coordinate privacy controls, DPIAs and transfer assessments across legal regimes. Explore this practical global data privacy programs course.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who coordinate personal data governance across legal, security, product and operational teams. It is designed for privacy roles that need to reconcile shared controls with distinct legal obligations.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with privacy, compliance, information security, product governance or data management is recommended. You do not need programming skills; exercises use privacy artefacts and spreadsheet-based analysis.
